title: Jensen Huang was reinstated because his failure to build a management structure fit for Nvidia's size, plus Trump's support, left Nvidia with no other options (Robert Armstrong/Financial Times)
summary: Robert Armstrong / Financial Times: Jensen Huang was reinstated because his failure to build a management structure fit for Nvidia's size, plus Trump's support, left Nvidia with no other options — Nvidia took Huang back because his failures left the company with no other options — If Jensen Huang had been a better CEO …
contentText:
Robert Armstrong / Financial Times :

Jensen Huang was reinstated because his failure to build a management structure fit for Nvidia's size, plus Trump's support, left Nvidia with no other options   —  Nvidia took Huang back because his failures left the company with no other options  —  If Jensen Huang had been a better CEO …
